attempts.sql: SELECT enclosing_class_symbol_id AS symbol_id, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS method_count FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE is_method AND NOT in_test_file AND enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY enclosing_class_symbol_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY method_count DESC, symbol_id ASC

request:
Which classes in the non-test code define at least 20 methods directly in their own body? Count every method definition separately (a property getter and its setter count as two; inherited methods and methods of nested classes do not count). Return each class's symbol ID and its method count, largest count first, ties broken by symbol ID alphabetically.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string), method_count (integer). Order the rows as the question asks.
explanation: Groups method symbols by their enclosing class, excluding test files and methods of nested classes (which have a different enclosing class). Counts each method definition separately and keeps classes with at least 20 direct methods, ordered by count descending then symbol ID.
sql: SELECT enclosing_class_symbol_id AS symbol_id, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS method_count FROM code.symbol_profile WHERE is_method AND NOT in_test_file AND enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY enclosing_class_symbol_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY method_count DESC, symbol_id ASC
